morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 将形容词 tenteram 名词化，表示安宁的状态。词根辅音保留；末尾 /m/ 在接元音开头的 -an 后成为末音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 社会、社区或环境没有骚乱和纷扰的安宁状态；安定。
senses.en_definition: A state of peace and freedom from disturbance or disorder.
senses.nuances: 强调秩序安定和免受滋扰，不只指没有声音。ketenteraman awam 通常译为“公共秩序”或“社会安宁”，不宜仅译为“公共安静”。该搭配见于 [马来西亚内政部政策文件](https://www.pmo.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Dasar-Keselamatan-Dan-Ketenteraman-Awam-2019.pdf)。马来语释义取自所给《Kamus Dewan》资料包。

senses.zh_definition: 思想、内心或情绪摆脱忧虑和激动后的平静、安宁。
senses.en_definition: Calmness or tranquillity of mind, heart, or feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Ketenangan fikiran, hati atau perasaan; keredaan.
senses.nuances: 指内在感受，常与 jiwa、hati 搭配。与快乐不同：人即使仍然悲伤，也可能逐渐获得这种安宁。马来语释义展开自所给《Kamus Dewan》资料包。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penganjur diminta mengawal tahap bunyi bagi memelihara ketenteraman penduduk setempat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主办方受促控制音量，以维护当地居民的安宁。
dual_scenarios.en: The organisers have been asked to control noise levels to preserve the peace of local residents.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Perlahankan muzik tu sikit, ya. Dah malam, nanti ganggu ketenteraman jiran.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong perlahankan muzik itu sedikit. Hari sudah malam; muzik yang kuat boleh mengganggu ketenteraman jiran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 音乐调小一点啊。已经晚上了，别吵到邻居。
dual_scenarios.en: Turn the music down a little, please. It's late, and we might disturb the neighbours.
spoken_features: nanti：在此提示可能出现的不良后果

etymology.historical_story: The transparent formation is tenteram enclosed by ke- and -an, turning a peaceful quality into a state. Its two dictionary senses connect public life with private feeling: a neighbourhood can enjoy ketenteraman, and so can a troubled heart. Malaysian institutional language particularly favours ketenteraman awam. A deeper historical origin for tenteram is not established here. See [Malaysia's public-security policy](https://www.pmo.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Dasar-Keselamatan-Dan-Ketenteraman-Awam-2019.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tenteram＝安宁；ke-...-an 给它套上“状态”外框：ketenteraman＝安宁的状态。联想“外面无纷扰，里面心安稳”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词语中性而偏正式。提醒邻居注意安宁时，可用 Tolong 或 Mohon 开头，说明具体噪声问题，比直接指责对方扰乱公共秩序更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合社区通知、新闻报道及表达内心安宁。日常只想让人小声一点时，Perlahankan suara sedikit 更直接自然；ketenteraman 常出现在说明原因的部分。
